segments: Kintex Ultrascale+ FPGA supporting STANAG3350 / RGB / VGA, DVI, ARINC818 interfaces HDD/HRS/TP16/1.01
DVI/TMDS Video Inputs: FPGA shall be interfaced with maximum 3x DVI/TMDS Video inputs.

Video Encoder Interface: FPGA shall be interfaced with three Video encoder IC via RGB parallel data bus interface on IO bank for Video output from FPGA to XMC Secondary Connector; FPGA shall supply required reference clock for the Video encoder IC; Video encoder IC shall be configured by FPGA.
DVI Video Output: FPGA shall provide 1x DVI video output interfaced to DVI equalizer IC.

ARINC 818 Interface: ARINC 818 high speed video protocol shall be implemented on FPGA MGT bank; 3x ARINC 818 Video output & input channels shall be implemented. Reference clock from clock generator to FPGA MGT bank will be used for ARINC 818.
Temperature sensor: FPGA shall read on temperature sensor via I2C interface on IO bank.
SPI Flash memory interface: FPGA shall implement logic to write & read external SPI Flash memory via SPI interface implemented on IO bank.
